dataset_title: Roadside-grass feed and digestate observations from Grassification D1.4.1
source_title: D 1.4.1. Co-digestion of roadside grass with VeDoWS manure and pig slurry
source_locations: Table 3, digestate columns dated 09/04/2020, 15/04/2020, 23/04/2020 and ambiguously 05/05/2020 or 25/05/2020
Figure 9 caption, report p. 12: batch BMP milestones at 3 and 8 days
license: No explicit reuse license identified in the report or accessible project metadata; factual observations transcribed with source attribution.
data_basis: Roadside grass ensiled in a trench silo and co-digested with VeDoWS manure and pig slurry at the Inagro pilot. Feed characterization and co-digestate observations remain on the reported bases and units; no unit or basis conversion is applied.
applicability: Reference-only evidence for roadside-grass feed characterization and mixed-feed anaerobic digestion/digestate composition. It is not a GreenHub measurement, not a grass-only digestate, and not the protein-depleted GreenHub residual stream.
limitations: The digester feed included manure and pig slurry; digestate composition and residual BMP cannot be attributed to grass alone.
The pilot experienced an interruption after motor failure; the report describes non-steady operating periods, so no stable kinetic or continuous yield factor is inferred.
The final Table 3 sampling date is rendered as 05/05/2020 or 25/05/2020 and is preserved as ambiguous text.
The reported ammonium-N value 0.73 ± 13.13 is retained verbatim but flagged as a source anomaly and must not be used quantitatively without verification.

Figure 9 reports that roadside-grass batch BMP reached 60% of its maximum after 3 days and 90% after 8 days. Raw time-series values and uncertainty are unavailable; these milestones are not continuous-reactor HRT or GreenHub residual-stream kinetics, and no curve is fitted.
Several Table 3 bases and standard gas-volume conditions are incompletely specified; no normalization or derived methane yield is calculated.
The report's reuse license was not identified; the dataset is not redistributed as a full-text substitute.
retrieval_and_transcription_note: Source title, author, date and pilot context checked against the public report. Records are a structured transcription of reported values, not a reanalysis or model calibration dataset.
